units.name: Department of Management Science
units.evidence: Actual department explicitly identifies Management Theory and Industrial Engineering research discipline, Operation Management, Quality Management, Logistics and Supply-chain Management.

decisions.reason: Operations Management is a verified research orientation; actual Department of Management Science independently documents this remit. No standalone Operations Management department established.

sources.note: Entire official English SEM home read. Exact School of Economics and Management, Tongji University; current PhD programme menu and department links.

Entire PhD overview read. Three first-level doctoral programmes Management Science and Engineering, Business Administration and Applied Economics; doctoral dissertation defence, academic publications and corresponding doctoral degree. International MSE and Business Administration doctoral training explicitly develops scientific research capabilities.

Entire Doctor of Management Science programme page read. MSE discipline explicitly describes Ph.D. candidates, independent innovative research, dissertation and 28 credits. Research orientations include Supply Chain Management and Decision Analysis; Management theory and Industrial Engineering; Operations Management and Intelligent Decision-Making. One broad doctoral programme with nested research orientations.

Entire official English department page read. Actual body names Department of Management Science. Research discipline Management Theory and Industrial Engineering explicitly includes Quality Management, Operation Management, Logistics and Supply-chain Management. Department URL and Chinese translated menu use longer Management Science and Engineering wording; no second department inferred.

Entire programme read. Academic research doctorate within PhD section, dissertation and 30 credits. Five research orientations strategic management, technological economics/innovation/entrepreneurship, organisation/HR, marketing and accounting; no relevant Operations field established. Exact Doctor of Business Administration wording not automatically interpreted as professional DBA.

Entire research page AX text read. Browser title School of Mechanical Engineering and Robotics, body School of Mechanical Engineering. Generic doctoral programmes Mechanical Engineering and Power Engineering and Engineering Thermophysics; intelligent manufacturing/construction, control and energy research do not independently establish an IE/Operations doctoral specialization or exact credential.

Entire Master and PhD program page read. Vehicle Engineering and Vehicle Operation Engineering sections explicitly award master degrees. Transportation Engineering discusses doctoral history and research orientations including logistics system planning and operation management, but final award statement explicitly master degree. Current doctoral credential and exact host mapping not resolved; no additional PhD counted.

limitations: Imported Operations Management is a substantive doctoral research orientation, not a verified standalone administrative department; mapped to actual Department of Management Science with its explicit Operations and logistics research remit.

Official English department body uses Department of Management Science while URL and translated Chinese menu use Management Science and Engineering wording; historical/current naming discrepancy retained.
Wider engineering, transport and mathematical doctoral coverage remains incomplete. Mixed master/doctoral transport history page does not establish a current exact doctoral award.
